subject: Demo Coordination: US/EU DST Crossover — Weekend Swap and Coverage Plan
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@northbridge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@northbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Quick: demo times next week (US/EU DST crossover)

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We'd like to lock a 45-min demo for the team to walk through inference economics and the Dedicated offering. A couple constraints:
- We have engineers in Madrid (CET) and a small NYC presence.
- US switches to DST this Sunday (Mar 8), and our EU folks don't switch until later this month — want to avoid everyone showing up an hour early/late.

Proposed slots (all local times included):
1) Tue Mar 10, 10:00 CET / Tue Mar 10, 05:00 EDT — too early for NYC, likely no.
2) Tue Mar 10, 16:00 CET / Tue Mar 10, 11:00 EDT — works but conflicts with a board meeting for two of our engineers.
3) Sat Mar 14, 10:00 CET / Sat Mar 14, 05:00 EDT — tentative, we can ask a couple folks to join early on weekend.

If you have a preference or a fallback window, please share. I've attached a short agenda and a .ics with our calendar availability.

Thanks —
Maria
Head of Platform Engineering
Northbridge Capital

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (1 page), proposed-calendar.ics (availability grid)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@northbridge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@northbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick: demo times next week (US/EU DST crossover)

Maria —

Really appreciate the context. You're exactly right — this coming week is a pain because the US jumps forward on Mar 8 and EU stays on standard time until later. That produces a 5-hour gap (vs usual 6) for a couple days and then flips back later, which is how people get double-booked.

Quick notes / suggested plan:
- We can run a focused 35-min demo + 10-min Q&A to keep it tight for people joining early/late.
- If weekday is preferable for Northbridge engineers, Tue Mar 10 at 11:00 EDT / 16:00 CET works for our product lead (Grace) and Marcus can join for the Q&A.
- Alternatively, to avoid weekday conflicts, we can do Sat Mar 14 at 09:30 EDT / 14:30 CET — earlier for NYC but gives EU folks the usual afternoon slot.
- As a fallback, propose a staggered plan: run the demo live at Tue 11:00 EDT and record a short variant for the EU engineers who can't attend; follow with a 20-min sync for EU at Tue 18:00 CET (which is 13:00 EDT) if that helps.

I'll pencil Tue 11:00 EDT / 16:00 CET and Sat 09:30 EDT / 14:30 CET on my calendar as options and attach a tentative .ics. Can you confirm availability for Tom + two engineers (name(s)?) so we can lock the slot?

Best,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: provisional-demo.ics

Sean / Maria —

Thanks for the options. A few quick points from our side:
- The Tue morning (NYC) slot collides with an internal incident review for two of our infra folks — they can't shift.
- Sat is better for the engineers but I want to avoid weekend work if possible.
- If you run Tue at 11:00 EDT and record, we can have a 20-min follow-up sync Tue 18:00 CET for the EU team, as Sean suggested. That keeps weekdays intact and minimizes weekend asks.

If that works, please send the recording link + a separate calendar invite for the Tue 18:00 CET sync so we can get it on calendars.

Tom
Director, Platform Ops
Northbridge Capital

Tom / Maria —

Thanks for confirming. Plan we locked:
1) Live demo: Tue Mar 10, 11:00 EDT / 16:00 CET — 35-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Grace will lead the walkthrough; Marcus will cover deployment and SLA questions during Q&A.
2) Short recording: we'll circulate a 12–15 minute clip focused on the deployment and routing controls (for anyone who misses the live session).
3) Follow-up sync: Tue Mar 10, 18:00 CET / 13:00 EDT — 20-min drop-in for EU engineers to ask region-specific questions.

I've attached the final agenda and a consolidated .ics with the three calendar items (live demo, recording placeholder, EU follow-up). You should see invites coming from my calendar in ~5 minutes.

Two quick asks:
- Maria: please confirm the two engineers who need the recording + whether they prefer a 1:1 follow-up instead of the 20-min drop-in.
- Tom: if you want any specific deployment examples covered, flag them so Marcus can prep slides (e.g., VPC-only deployment, KMS integration, or audit-log retention policies).

Appreciate the flexibility during the DST crossover week — we've run into this pattern before and the split live+recording approach cuts across schedules well.

Best,
Sean
